aʕle w ʕal i aṯto coordinates two ʕal-marked appeal addressees. Unprefixed first-plural mdaxlina is a projected collective proposal in Infectum, with no new box.

The earlier entry explicitly requested expansion because the scanned translation page was absent. This job corrects the existing example in place, preserving its id, sense number and reference, rather than filling the same cell with a duplicate.

Jan Beṯ-Şawoce has no edition translation. English quotations below retain the supplied project machine translation and are marked as such; sense decisions rest on the Turoyo. Where available, round-1 proposals are retained in the human layout and counts, and are not resubmitted in this JSON.

II.1 takes a b-marked domain in baš šəwolani, parallel to b-u=ḥarb in the inherited example. In this written religious discussion, klozəm d lə mdaxli places Infectum under a negative obligation. It provides no evidence for a new lexical sense or for II.2 um Gnade bitten.
Does the target marking ʕal remain obligatory with sense 2 in other dialects? One example establishes the attested pattern but cannot establish obligatory government.
